decision: Preserve candidate003. Covariance improvement reverses on second repartition; morphology fusion is inconsistent; matched256 ensemble is worse on all3partitions.
source_attribution: Covariance descriptor and joint head are original project implementations using existing project TinyCNN and installed PyTorch. No external code, pretrained weights or training data were introduced.
diagnosis: Covariance increases train fit substantially; train-vs-validation gap and late validation degradation indicate overfitting under this fixed schedule.
Covariance errors are less correlated with baseline errors, but complementarity does not consistently offset individual error.
256px baseline residual correlation around0.91vs0.83-0.85for128px limits fixed-blend diversity. This does not establish that native resolution has no useful information.
possible_next_control_not_executed: If continuing, a single predeclared covariance regularization control (smaller covariance rank/head, shrink covariance toward its diagonal) directly targets the observed generalization gap. Do not select epochs retroactively from these validation curves. This is a testable direction, not evidence of a likely winning model.
scope: Development400 only; baseline/kernel/CNNs refit within every outer fold. Three reused partitions do not remove historical model-selection bias. No holdout/test/full500 fitting in this study.
limits: This rejects these configurations as replacements for003, not a technical performance ceiling.
